local_tax_note: This estimate excludes Ohio municipal income tax — and for most Ohio taxpayers, this is the single biggest gap in a paycheck estimate. Over 600 Ohio municipalities levy their own income tax, typically 1%-3%, with Columbus, Cleveland, and Akron around 2.5%. For many urban Ohio workers, city tax exceeds the state tax computed here. Check your city's rate via RITA, CCA, or your municipality's finance department.
deviation_note: This is an estimate based on standard single-filer federal, FICA, and OH state calculations. Actual withholding may differ based on your W-4/IT-4 elections, pre-tax deductions, municipal tax, and other factors. Some early secondary sources disagreed on whether OH 2026 has one bracket or an additional tier above $100,000 — resolved: House Bill 96 (the FY2026-27 state budget) completed the phase-down to a single 2.75% bracket with no additional tier, confirmed by multiple independent sources citing that bill.
